scope.qualified: A player already confused while an incoming move may lower Attack
scope.defense_bound: observed live self-hit Defense; an Attack drop cannot reduce it

review_correction: Initial reviews proposed using observed live Attack. A reachable burn-plus-badge-glitch counterexample disproved that narrower bound before implementation. Both independent reviewers accepted the correction to the cartridge-wide 999 Attack cap.
verified_conclusion: The compound confusion-plus-Attack-drop boundary now has a conservative cartridge-generic bound and the retained Lorelei state exposes a strictly safe attack without input. This qualifies engineering for a separately identified development successor after green CI; it does not complete Lorelei, prove renewable funding or advance model learning.
